description: The file contains the main Program class for the Benchmarks project, centralizing the orchestration of various performance benchmarks including MapReduce, Transactions, Ping (latency tests), Grain Storage, and specific test suites. It defines a dictionary of benchmark actions, supports command-line arguments for selective or full execution, and includes utility methods for benchmarking execution.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: The main class that contains the program entry point and manages execution of various benchmarks based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Entry point for the application; parses command-line arguments and executes selected benchmarks or the full suite.

methods.name: RunBenchmark
methods.description: Utility method to execute a benchmark, measure elapsed time, and handle setup/teardown.
